reden: Yes. The audit report explicitly identifies the same issue: at block.timestamp == auctionEndTime, claimAuction (>=) and cancelBid/cancelAllBids (<=) are simultaneously callable, and claimAuction refunds non-winning bids without setting status=false (and doesn’t clear the winner’s status either). This allows a bidder/winner to call cancelBid in the same block (or via reentrancy) to receive a second refund, letting the winner get the NFT for free and draining ETH from other auctions. The report cites the same functions (claimAuction, cancelBid, cancelAllBids), the same mechanism (time overlap + missing status clearing), and the same effective fixes (use strict inequality and set status=false before/when refunding). An attack that works in the description works against the report’s finding and vice versa.
